Jianwen's contemporary assessment that Xie Feng's learning does not match Kong Yan.
Jianwen concludes that Xie Feng nevertheless naturally surpasses in some quality, part of the same contemporary judgment.
Annotation identifies Xie Feng's younger brother as Xie Pin, courtesy name Hong, providing genealogical background.
Annotation notes that Xie Annan refers to Xie Feng, already seen elsewhere in the text, providing identification background.
Annotation records that (Xie Pin) successively held the office of Palace Attendant (侍中), an office history detail.
Annotation records the office of Commandant of Justice (廷尉卿), part of the official career background.
Annotation gives Kong Yan's origin as Shanyin and his father Kong Jian as Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, biographical background.
Annotation gives Kong Yan's courtesy name as Pengzu, biographical background.
